question: Should this PR require redacted real Feishu Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked-client proof for this narrow media fallback fix?
rationale: The production patch reuses the already-shipped text/card fallback helper and is source-backed, but repository policy treats external channel delivery changes as needing real behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally waives that gap.

options.title: Require real Feishu proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real Feishu setup proves image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal with private details redacted.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer can merge based on the narrow helper reuse and tests while explicitly owning the remaining live transport uncertainty.

options.title: Choose another candidate
options.body: If maintainers prefer a different same-root-cause branch, close or pause this branch only after the chosen branch has a viable proof and landing path.

recommendation.title: Require real Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real Feishu setup proves image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal with private details redacted.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and merged the existing Feishu reply fallback contract that the PR extends, making them the strongest available proof-sufficiency owner.
